messages:
priya: quick note  post kernel-binning + kvcache refactor we observed p95 uplift on small payloads; flame shows tokenize + grpc writev spikes. adding notes.
matt: can you share top stacks? is this specific to streams <256B?
priya: yes. top CPU samples: token::tokenize, grpc::writev (many tiny syscalls), http::parse_headers, kvcache::lookup (hot-shard fallback), kernel_selector::score. smallwrite count up ~2x for <256B streams.
anya: ran a microcanary: legacy kernel hint pool vs rollout. p95: legacy 236ms, rollout 262ms. smallwrites: 0.12 -> 0.29/wreq.
kevin: I prototyped a host-proxy coalesce buffer (configurable window_ms + max_bytes). cheap to enable behind flag.
sara: started canary: pool-A (coalesce=1ms), pool-B (legacy-hint). initial 20m snapshot: coalesce p95 down ~15% vs rollout, smallwrites down ~70%. kvcache miss unchanged.
ben: repro'd locally. hypothesis: kernel hinting shifted token boundaries so framer emits more tiny frames; grpc writev syscall rate increases and we pay syscall overhead. kvcache fallback increase is orthogonal but amplifies CPU.
priya: proposed actions: 1) enable host-proxy coalesce behind kill-switch for 48h 2) add per-shard kvcache telemetry 3) smaller kernel-hint diff + microbench after each tweak.
matt: +1. i'll add dashboards for smallwrite rate, p95 ingress, kvcache_miss_by_shard.
devops-bot: reminder: any change to host-proxy must include rollback runbook and canary checklist.
anya: logging outcome here; will open follow-ups: KERNEL_HINT_BISECT ticket, KVCACHE_SHARD_METRICS ticket, HOST_PROXY_COALESCE rollout ticket.
priya: thanks all  will sync tomorrow 10am to finalize roll plan.
